verdict.rationale: Dagster provides asset checks that can validate schema and null constraints, and integrates with dbt/dlt/Fivetran which handle typed, deduplicated table materialization, but Dagster itself is an orchestrator rather than a transformation engine that directly produces typed destination tables from raw JSON — that work is delegated to integrated tools. Missing for 10: first-party evidence of Dagster natively deduplicating/typing loaded data (vs. relying on dbt/dlt schema handling), and no independent/hands-on confirmation that asset checks + dbt integration reliably prevent raw-JSON landing in practice.
